definitions.window: CSV 0 invalid boot + 120 valid warm frames excluded; CSV 121..600 = 480 steady samples per run
definitions.quantiles: NumPy linear p95, independently checked against sorted-index interpolation; median independently checked using statistics.median
definitions.CPUThreadMax: Per-frame max(GameThreadTime, RenderThreadTime, RHIThreadTime), includes engine waits; proxy, not exclusive CPU work or sum of threads
definitions.sampling_unit: Five paired rounds. Run quantiles are contrasted within each view/round. No pooling of frame samples to pretend independent rounds.
definitions.interval: Student t 95% interval for mean paired difference, df4; n=5 and desktop/iGPU variability limit confidence. Not an equivalence test.
definitions.far_views: 500/1000m report S within A and within B only; no N contrast or geometry ranking
definitions.moving: Excluded from static rankings; all moving GPU data diagnostic only
